releases.name: v0.2.2
releases.bodyZh: 来自 @MegaPiggy 的更多 API 相关内容。

releases.name: v0.2.1
releases.body: Added @MegaPiggy's changes to add an API and stuff.
releases.bodyZh: 添加了 @MegaPiggy 的更改，以添加 API 和其他东西。

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.body:
Added a list of projectiles to cycle through and text in the suit HUD to show the selected projectile.
The list currently only consists of meteors and marshmallows.
releases.bodyZh:
新增了一个投射物列表用于循环切换，并在宇航服HUD界面显示所选投射物。
该列表目前仅包含流星和棉花糖。

releases.name: v0.1.5
releases.body:
Made meteors actually go in the direction you shoot them.
Previously they flew off in a weird direction; now they don't.
releases.bodyZh:
使陨石确实按照你射击的方向飞行。
之前它们会飞向奇怪的方向；现在不会了。

releases.name: v0.1.4
releases.body: Meteors are now launched from the player's hand when using NomaiVR.
releases.bodyZh: 使用NomaiVR时，流星现在从玩家的手中发射。

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body:
Added NomaiVR support. You must enable "Use back button" in the mod options menu to launch meteors in VR.
It currently uses the head rotation, but in the future I hope to make it use the hand rotation.

releases.name: v0.1.2
releases.body: Added option to change the size of the meteors you launch.

releases.name: v0.1.1
releases.body:
Added an option in the mod settings to use the back button to fire meteors, allowing support for controllers.
That, along with using the `FirstPersonManipulator` instead of the camera for the launch rotation, will hopefully allow for future NomaiVR support.

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.body: Middle mouse click to shoot. It doesn't work on controller or in VR yet.
